in_sanskrit.name: Sukram
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who brings the auspicious planet Shukra (Venus) to one's side, or the embodiment of Shukra himself who bestows good fortune.

in_hindi.name: शुक्रम
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who brings the bright, shining, and auspicious planet Shukra (Venus) to one's side, or the embodiment of Shukra himself who bestows good fortune.

in_tamil.name: Sukram
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Born of the Moon
in_tamil.long_meaning: Sukram ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। One who is born from the Moon, represented by the planet Mercury in Hindu astrology.

in_telugu.name: Sukram
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Born of the Moon
in_telugu.long_meaning: Sukram ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। One who is born from the Moon, represented by the planet Mercury in Hindu astrology.

in_marathi.name: Sukram
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Born of the Moon
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sukram हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is born from the Moon, represented by the planet Mercury in Hindu astrology.

in_bengali.name: Sukram
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Born of the Moon
in_bengali.long_meaning: Sukram একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who is born from the Moon, represented by the planet Mercury in Hindu astrology.
